questions.question: Dr. Leila, now a national reference for young dentists, is invited to an international congress. What message should she carry?
options: Training young dentists is a constraint
Supporting young dentists is the key to the profession's future
Young dentists are reserved for specialists
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Supporting young dentists is the key to the profession's future.' Karim: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create a foundation to promote the careers of young dentists. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Promoting support and training is essential for the future.' Dr. Leila: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must write a reference book on the careers of young dentists. What is the central message?
options: Career is an art that combines preparation and passion
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Career is an art that combines preparation and passion.' Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should he leave?
options: Young dentists' careers are in decline
Young dentists' careers are full of opportunities
Young dentists' careers have no future
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Young dentists' careers are full of opportunities.' Dr. Leila: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must create a mentoring program for young dentists. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental skills.' Karim: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must manage the succession of his commitment to young dentists. What is the best strategy?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Gradual preparation of transmission is the key to a successful succession.' Dr. Leila: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must create a charter for supporting young dentists. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Benevolence and transmission are the pillars of any support charter.' Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must train future mentors of young dentists. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' Dr. Leila: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must prepare a testimony on her journey of supporting young dentists. What is the most striking element?
options: The joy of seeing young dentists succeed
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The joy of seeing young dentists succeed is the most striking element.' Karim: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create an alumni association of mentors. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the link and foster mutual support
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Mutual support and the link are the driving forces of an alumni association of mentors.' Dr. Leila: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must write an article on the future of young dentists. What trend should be highlighted?
options: The decrease in demand for dentists
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The importance of personalized support is a promising trend.' Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create a quality label for supporting young dentists. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'The quality of support and mentoring are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Leila: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The profession needs transmission enthusiasts.' Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create an award for young dentists. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Stimulating professional excellence is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' Dr. Leila: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must write her memoirs. What is the common thread to highlight?
options: The passion for support and mentoring
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The passion for support is the common thread of a professional life.' Karim: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create a training center for young dentists. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Training must produce complete and fulfilled professionals.' Dr. Leila: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Mentoring skills and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Mentoring skills and an example to follow are the most beautiful legacy.' Karim: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must write a letter to future dentists about their career. What message should it convey?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Career is an exciting adventure.' Dr. Leila: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Leila must create a scholarship for young dentists. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Supporting deserving young dentists is an investment for the future.' Karim: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must give a closing speech. What note should he leave?
options: Career continues to evolve with those who live it
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Career continues to evolve with those who live it.' Dr. Leila: 'I completely agree.'

options: Sell her knowledge at the highest price
Transmit in the continuity of skills

questions.question: Dr. Karim must create a peer network for young dentists. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young dentists.' Dr. Leila: 'I will support this network.'

options: Career is a magnificent human adventure

options: Career is a discipline worth experiencing

questions.explanation: Dr. Leila concludes: 'Career needs passion and transmission to continue evolving.' Dr. Karim: 'I am proud of you.'
